meta.promptToUse: Query EDI Prod MCP Server with EDI-Prod-filter-workitems: Query 1 - product='ENT', changeType=['FIX'], createdAfter='2026-10-06', createdBefore='2026-11-05', top=50, skip=0 (then continue pagination with skip=50, 100, etc.).
